design.name: Olai
design.description: A palm-leaf invitation on a brass plate, three sacred knots and a blessing etched by each guest.
design.interaction: Let guests etch a palm-leaf blessing

html:
Dear Your Family,

A sacred invitation awaits you

Written on palm leaves, with love

Best with sound on
Shri Ganeshaya Namah
Dear Your Family,

Senthil&Abirami

invite you to bless their wedding
Thursday · 4 February 2027
Madurai

SCROLL

The couple

Senthil & Abirami

With the blessings of our family deity and our elders

Mr. R. Muthukumar & Mrs. M. Valli
request the pleasure of your company at the wedding of their son

Senthil

with

Abirami

daughter of Mr. S. Ganesan & Mrs. G. Kamala

Two days of blessings

The Reception & the Muhurtham

Wednesday · 3 February 2027

Reception

7:00 PM onwards
Heritage Madurai

Dinner will be served

Directions Add to calendar
Thursday · 4 February 2027

Muhurtham

7:30 to 9:00 AM
Thiruparankundram, Madurai

Breakfast and lunch on banana leaf follow

Directions Add to calendar

The muhurtham

Moonu Mudichu

Three knots, one lifetimeScroll slowly to tie the thaali

The first knota promise to each other

The second knota bond between our two families

The third knotwith God as our witness

Getti melam!

IIIIII

Like our grandparents did

Etch your blessing

Write a blessing for Senthil and Abirami and watch it carved onto a palm leaf.

May you two be blessed with a long, happy life together.Your Family
Send this blessing on WhatsApp

Good to know

Things to know

What to wear

Traditional silks and veshtis. Jasmine is welcome!

The feast

Breakfast and lunch served on banana leaf after the muhurtham.

Come early

The muhurtham begins at 7:30 AM sharp. Please be seated by 7:15.

Your stay

Travelling to Madurai? Tell us in your RSVP and we will help with rooms.

RSVP

Will you bless us in person?

Kindly reply by 20 January 2027.

Will you attend?
You'll join us for
Number of guests
2

Please add your name so the family knows who replied.

Your reply goes directly to the hosts through WhatsApp.

With the blessings of our elders, we begin our life together.

Counting down to the muhurtham

82DAYS
07HOURS
40MINUTES
07SECONDS

The Muthukumar & Ganesan families

#SenthilWedsAbirami

Senthil and Abirami at their reception, on a stage of jasmine strings and brass lamps
